subject: E-5292: upload stalls on Windows
body:
Hello support team. We run CourierOS 3.5.3 on Windows 11 24H2. Since this
morning, every time I upload a file, I get 'E-5292: upload stalled at 0
bytes/s'.

It started when I began working from home over the VPN. On the office network
with no VPN the uploads complete.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed nothing.

Kenji Sato - Oakline Partners. Appreciate any pointers.
